verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no user-facing feature for importing mail history or contacts from another provider or client. The only related item is a line listing 'email account migration' as a Gmail API use case, which is a developer building block rather than a switcher import feature. IMAP/POP support covers other clients accessing Gmail, not importing into it, and nothing in the pack covers importing contacts.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
